### What Does the Rainbow Really Mean? - The Crosswalk Devotional - March 16
Author: Rev. Kyle Norman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/what-does-the-rainbow-really-mean-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Genesis 9:16
Points:
- Traumatic experiences make people fearful whenever storm clouds gather and rain begins to fall.
- The rainbow is an active sign of divine promise rather than a tool to jog God's memory.
- God provided the covenant sign to comfort human hearts prone to anxiety and doubt.
- The bow in the sky reassures believers that grace, love, and mercy outshine the darkest clouds.

### Signs of the Covenant
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/signs-covenant
Passage: Genesis 9:16
Points:
- Violent storms remind us of nature's power, but God promised never to destroy all life by water again.
- The bow in the clouds depicts a warrior's weapon hung up, representing God's peaceful truce with creation.
- God's covenant sign prefigures baptism and the Lord's Supper as physical seals of His faithfulness.
- The visible sign attached to God's Word strengthens the believer's hope and faith.

### The End Of The Rainbow
Author: Joan Walker Hahn
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/the-end-of-the-rainbow-encouragement-cafe-january-29.html
Passage: Genesis 9:14-15
Points:
- Noah and his family endured a terrifying, weeks-long storm before seeing God's covenant in the sky.
- In life, people must often walk through prolonged adversity before seeing how God works it for good.
- Even when circumstances offer no visible rainbow, Jesus is the mediator of an everlasting covenant.
- Enduring trials with patient trust deepens our appreciation for God's eventual deliverance.

### The Rainbow - One Year Devotions for Men
Author: Tyndale House Publishers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/the-rainbow-one-year-devotions-for-men-april-5.html
Passage: Genesis 9:13, 17
Points:
- Poetic appreciation and scientific analysis only explain the rainbow's appearance and natural mechanics.
- Divine revelation reveals the deeper truth that the rainbow represents God's binding covenant with the earth.
- Natural wonders find their richest meaning when viewed through the truth of Scripture.
- Observing God's faithfulness in creation should lead believers to worship and thanksgiving.
